summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with hands on experience in high performance and parallel computing. Built distributed simulations on a SLURM managed Linux cluster using MPI and optimized CUDA C++ kernels for GPU inference with memory coalescing, alongside Python and Git based development work across research and lab environments.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using HuggingFace's VisionEncoderDecoder API; added domain specific special tokens and resized decoder embedding layer accordingly.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture recognition glove for hands free cursor control integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Architected a Mixed Reality headset concept using AI based real time chroma keying without a green screen; produced full claims documentation and BOM.

projects.name: MPI Hodgkin-Huxley Neuron Simulation
bullets: Achieved up to 10.49x speedup with 12 slave processes on a SLURM managed cluster; characterized scaling behavior across dendrite counts and compartment depths.
Implemented distributed dendrite computations across MPI workers with synchronous soma updates.
Identified load imbalance effects showing up to 65% performance degradation under uneven work distribution.

projects.name: Parallel Ray Tracer with MPI Task Scheduling
bullets: Achieved up to 30x speedup with static strip partitioning (55 processes) rendering 5000x5000 pixel scenes using MPI.

Implemented and benchmarked four parallel work distribution strategies (static strip/block/cyclic, dynamic task queue); dynamic task queue outperformed all static methods under unpredictable workloads.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Coalesced kernel ran at 49.2ms vs 73.3ms (uncoalesced) and 77.5ms (CPU TorchScript), a ~35% speedup over naive GPU with identical classification accuracy.

Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing, constant memory for weights and biases, and preallocated global buffers to eliminate per layer allocation overhead.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Designed a custom BPE tokenizer with a Cython accelerated backend achieving 4 to 5.5x speedup over pure Python, processing 6M characters in 15 minutes.
Built an end-to-end ASR pipeline with an 80-channel mel spectrogram encoder and a 4-block causal Transformer decoder with cross-attention.
